Class EditorTracker

java.lang.Object
comp3607project.EditorTracker
public class EditorTracker extends Object
Tracks open BlueJ Java editors and attaches document listeners so text edits can be recorded as telemetry events.

This documentation is generated from a separate copy of the submitted source. The original project source files are not modified.
